title: Imposter syndrome is for amateurs
html:
You think to yourself, "I'm not qualified for this!"… but why?

Why exactly are you thinking that... is there some deeper-level insecurity?

Are you nervous that you'll be caught? Caught for what? Not being qualified?

Well, you got yourself here.

You're qualified because you're trying.

You're qualified because you're putting in the work.

You're qualified because you give a shit.

Next time that this feeling arises, reframe the conversation you have with yourself.

You should be here. You are competent. You are a professional.
